## Introduction

The Communications Authority of Kenya regulates the communications sector.
This report covers the quarter ending June 2026.

## Mobile devices

At the end of June 2026, 78.7 million mobile phone devices were connected to Kenyan networks.
Smartphones accounted for 63.7 percent of connected mobile phone devices.
The number of smartphones connected to mobile networks reached 52.3 million.

| Device category | Connected devices (millions) | Share |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Smartphones | 52.3 | 63.7% |
| Feature phones | 26.4 | 33.5% |

## Mobile broadband

Mobile broadband usage reached 800 million gigabytes, approximately 6 percent higher than the previous quarter.
